PHASE 2 LOCAL REPAIR COMPLETE — held-out RED/GREEN/mutation proof

RED: tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py::test_shared_pytest_job_has_incident_timeout was collected and executed before the workflow edit; it failed with None != 60. The oracle was then removed from the fixer worktree.

FIX: isolated fixer, without access to tests/, added only jobs.test.timeout-minutes: 60 in .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml. Both test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml inherit it from the reusable workflow.

GREEN: restored held-out oracle passed. Defect-seeded mutation removed timeout-minutes and returned the unchanged oracle to RED with None != 60; restored fix returned GREEN. Refactoring litmus passes: the test asserts the public YAML job contract and is insensitive to private code naming/refactors.

Verification: 15 targeted workflow/blobless tests passed; make lint passed (ruff, formatting, DCO identity, actionlint); make config-check passed; PyYAML parse confirmed jobs.test.timeout-minutes == 60; git diff --check passed; commit hook lint + full-tree mypy passed. One concurrent verification attempt tripped the repo-root leak fixture because make lint created .ruff_cache during pytest; the sequential rerun was 15/15 green, confirming test-command interference rather than a product failure. No dependency added, no existing test weakened, no new capability beyond bounding the existing job. No sibling timeout omission was changed: other jobs are outside the confirmed pytest-capacity incident.

Local signed commit: 0d3d27aa2 (rebar-ticket verified; Change-Id hook applied). Worktree clean. Local review found no correctness/readability/architecture/security/performance findings; rebar review-code reported capability disabled by config.

LIVE STATE at 2026-08-01T00:56:59Z: reruns 30675030213, 30675031552, 30675032723, 30675034104 remain in_progress; run 30676012105 remains queued. No live run was cancelled/rerun and nothing was pushed. The rebar-debug approval gate requires explicit operator approval before those shared-system mutations. Stale Gerrit changes 1129/1130/1131/1136 are still NEW and omit 96a0d5c3f; rebasing the stack is a separate shared Gerrit mutation and the first change has a current-main content conflict requiring human review.
